_about: Pins for Pinterest auto-publish, served as RSS at https://hoopdeck.app/pins/feed.xml. The Coach Shop agent adds a pin here only after Lucas approves it on the ship. An item shows in the feed once its date has passed.

items.title: Fair minutes for every player, planned in minutes
items.description: Equal playing time without the maths on the bench. This printable basketball rotation sheet splits each quarter into two blocks, so you tick who is on court and every junior player gets a fair share. Includes a fair-share table for 6 to 12 players. Part of the Game-Day Kit: fillable PDF, A4 and US Letter, instant download, A$7.

items.title: Everything for game day on 5 printable sheets
items.description: A printable coach clipboard for junior basketball: equal-minutes rotation planner, sub and minutes tracker, timeout sheets with a half court, a simple youth basketball stat sheet and a running scoresheet. Print it tonight, use it Saturday. Game-Day Kit: fillable PDF, A4 and US Letter, instant download, A$7.

items.title: Make every timeout count with one clear message
items.description: Basketball timeout sheets for junior coaches: 4 printable timeout cards, each with a half court to draw the play, plus space for one thing to keep doing and one thing to fix. Short and clear beats a long talk. Part of the Game-Day Kit: fillable PDF, A4 and US Letter, instant download, A$7.

items.title: Simple stats any parent can keep from the bench
items.description: A youth basketball stat sheet a volunteer parent can actually keep: tally points, 2PT, 3PT and free throws made and attempted, rebounds, assists, steals, turnovers and hustle plays on one page. Printable basketball stat sheet from the Game-Day Kit: fillable PDF, A4 and US Letter, instant download, A$7.
